activationRule: validate complete effective configuration, then atomically swap; otherwise use complete built-ins

scenarios.name: missing file
scenarios.result: complete typed built-ins activated; no path is created
scenarios.test: U-CFG-01 missing deterministic path activates embedded defaults without creating a file

scenarios.name: valid sparse file
scenarios.result: sparse values overlay typed defaults and activate after full validation
scenarios.test: U-CFG-03 valid partial user config activates only after complete validation

scenarios.name: mixed invalid file
scenarios.result: schema and semantic diagnostics aggregate; zero user values leak into fallback
scenarios.test: U-CFG-09 any mixed decoder or semantic error falls back atomically with aggregated diagnostics

scenarios.name: generated default documentation
scenarios.result: generated TOML decodes to the sole typed runtime default
scenarios.test: U-CFG-10 generated default TOML round-trips to the sole runtime default
